name: Uznat gertsoginyu: Yezhevika-yabloko
source:
The Duchess of Darkmoor has a steel crown, an ill reputation at the royal court, and a seat among the high sorcerers of the Magisterium. The flawed werefox has not a penny to her name, a scattering of freckles on her skin, and countless scars on her body. No one can weave their threads into a single pattern—shapeshifters steer clear of Darkmoor, and duchesses do not converse with riffraff.

[From [url=https://j-heliocentrist.itch.io/know-the-duchess-blackberry-apple]itch.io[/url]]
